question: Which state's government has granted approval for the 'Location Accessible Multi-modal Initiative (LACCMI)' scheme, aimed at establishing a sustainable, affordable, and safe transportation network for passengers and goods across the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The government of Odisha has granted approval for the 'Location Accessible Multi-modal Initiative (LACCMI)' scheme.
 
• The LACCMI scheme aims to establish a sustainable, affordable, and safe transportation network.
 
• This initiative is designed to cater to the needs of both passengers and goods across the state.
 
• The scheme is part of Odisha's efforts to enhance its transportation infrastructure and connectivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustainable Transportation**

 
 
• Sustainable transportation refers to the provision of services and infrastructure for the mobility of people and goods in a manner that is safe, affordable, and environmentally friendly.
 
• It aims to reduce the negative impacts of transportation on the environment and human health.
 
• Sustainable transportation includes the development of public transportation systems, promotion of non-motorized transport, and the use of cleaner energy sources.
 
 
 
• **Affordable Transportation**
 
 
• Affordable transportation ensures that transportation costs are within the means of the general population.
 
• It focuses on reducing the financial burden on individuals and families, especially those from low-income groups.
 
• Affordable transportation can include subsidies, fare reductions, and the provision of low-cost alternatives.
 
 
 
• **Safe Transportation**
 
 
• Safe transportation ensures the safety and security of passengers and goods during transit.
 
• It involves implementing measures to prevent accidents, injuries, and crimes.
 
• Safety measures can include the use of modern technology, strict regulations, and continuous monitoring.
 
 
 
• **Multi-modal Transportation**
 
 
• Multi-modal transportation refers to the use of two or more modes of transportation to move people or goods.
 
• This approach aims to provide efficient and seamless connectivity across different transportation networks.
 
• Examples of multi-modal transportation include integrating bus, train, and ferry services, as well as combining road, rail, and air transportation for freight.
